verdict.rationale: TypeSafe documents Jev only as a hosted model served through `POST /v1/systemone`, and its scope statement says "the same weights serve every account." That implies hosted-only, closed weights, but the docs never explicitly say the weights are closed, publish no downloadable weights, and give no weights license. The Hugging Face open replicas are third-party reproductions, not TypeSafe products, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that Jev weights are closed (or downloadable weights under a stated license), and a documented license or model-card disclosure.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can download the model weights under a stated license and run them myself — or the platform is honest that weights are closed

citations.quote: the same weights serve every account. You shape its answers to your domain through the request rather than through per-account weights.
Every model on this page is served by the same endpoint, `POST /v1/systemone`.
